_what: The connector-facing RESOURCE INDEX the Connector Console renders (section 8). Content, not code — add an item here rather than hardcoding one in the console.
_rule: `clearedExternally` is the only thing that decides whether the console renders a LINK. It is false for every document whose own header carries an INTERNAL / STAGED / DRAFT / counsel-gated banner — the console lists the item and marks it not-yet-available instead of linking a document that is not cleared for external eyes. When in doubt: false.
_availability: now = usable today · launch = exists but not cleared to send until the launch gate · counsel = blocked on outside counsel · rung:<Rn> = gated on the trust ladder · per-connector = depends on that person's own record
